roles.name: fast_scan
roles.description: Luna: bounded text searches and extraction without reasoning overhead; use explorer if unavailable.

roles.name: explorer
roles.description: Luna: locate files, callers, configuration and evidence; return searched scope.

roles.name: deep_explorer
roles.description: Sol: investigate ambiguous behavior and interactions across components.

roles.name: worker
roles.description: Luna: straightforward edits with understood behavior and targeted checks.

roles.name: standard_worker
roles.description: Terra: bounded implementation needing interpretation of established patterns.

roles.name: complex_worker
roles.description: Sol: complex implementation, difficult diagnosis and interacting behavior.

roles.name: expert_worker
roles.description: Astra: hardest implementation or unresolved consequential failures; own diagnosis through validation.

roles.name: test_runner
roles.description: Luna: run known checks and collect failures; do not change source code.

roles.name: test_diagnostician
roles.description: Terra: reproduce and diagnose failures, including environment problems; do not change source code.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.description: Luna: scoped routine review against explicit requirements and checks.

roles.name: deep_reviewer
roles.description: Sol: consequential correctness, subtle regressions and integration review.

roles.name: security_reviewer
roles.description: Sol: security-sensitive trust boundaries with concrete exploit and impact evidence.

roles.name: planner
roles.description: Sol: resolve uncertain decomposition; return assignments, dependencies and acceptance checks.

roles.name: brainstorm
roles.description: Astra: develop concepts, generate possibilities and turn explicit ideation requests into useful directions.

roles.name: expert
roles.description: Astra: hardest planning, diagnosis or review; resolve consequential uncertainty and specialist disagreement.

roles.name: docs_researcher
roles.description: Luna: focused source lookup, API/version verification and evidence packets.

roles.name: web_searcher
roles.description: Luna: one bounded research angle without reasoning overhead; use docs_researcher if unavailable.

roles.name: web_coordinator
roles.description: Luna: isolate substantial research coordination; delegate independent questions and process results as they arrive.

roles.name: web_verifier
roles.description: Sol: verify disputed, consequential or weakly supported claims with targeted follow-up sources.
